description: Parse CSV/TSV data and compute per-column summary statistics: null and unique-value counts for every column, plus min/max/mean/median/standard deviation for any column where every non-empty value parses as a plain number. A column with any non-numeric non-empty value is treated as categorical, reporting the most frequent value and its count instead.

csv.description: The CSV/TSV data, with a header row by default

hasHeader.description: Whether the first row is a header row, default true

name: summarize_csv_column_stats
